coverage.method: Inventoried every returned public fork excluding our own for branch reads; compared unique heads against checkout ancestry and pinned upstream. Screened changed paths, commit descriptions and targeted added-code terms, then inspected relevant implementations. This is not an exhaustive line-by-line audit of every fork or proof that an unlocated exact method does not exist.
coverage.evidence: Private source snapshots and comparison responses: artifacts/source-survey/. No fork code was executed.

findings.available: Native ScoringHUDViewModel line score, multiplier and trick-history presenter rows.
findings.integration: Adapted score/multiplier mappings into existing arcade_score_probe, preserving independent validity and emitting sanitized numeric telemetry. Forty strict parser checks and batch evidence tests added. No HUD replacement imported.
limits: Presentation lifetime includes a 2600 ms visual linger; never use it for combo grace or banking.
Local skater ownership and score semantics still need Deck correlation.
History rows linger and are not occurrence IDs; history traversal remains a follow-up.
Unknown formatting remains invalid rather than silently producing zero or multiplier one.

findings.available: Read-only local AntDriven state-page resolver for CurrentGrindType, CurrentSkateGrindType, CurrentFlipTrick and physical lip/handplant fields.
findings.integration: Reuse only bounded whitelisted state readers with owner/generation, timestamps, field-validity bits and reset handling; correlate against native grind physics and known labeled trials.
limits: No enum-to-named-grind mapping, supported numeric range or occurrence counter supplied.
read_grind_control and read_transition_state have no caller in inspected trainer source.
Enum.Intent.Manual and active input/control fields describe intent, not performed mechanics.
Discovery can scan writable regions for seconds; do not import whole tuning scan or state-writing hooks.

findings.available: knock_local_skater revalidates complete owner at selector delivery, requests native impact bit15 and records native cause13, then preserves original selector result.
findings.integration: Candidate for balance failure inside existing no_bail hook. Add one-shot serial ticket, expiry/cancel and independent native result acknowledgement before enabling.
limits: Original pending window can be refreshed and native consumption owns flag cleanup.
No success acknowledgement in this implementation.
Native 504 alone also means ordinary walking, not necessarily bail.

findings.available: Bounded serial request, scoped impact/animation bits across native consumers, full-owner checks, real ragdoll-entry observation and an authored wipeout predicate route.
findings.integration: Use request lifecycle and native entry observation as reference for physical balance consequences. Start with minimal native request; preserve native rejection and existing No Bail policy.
limits: Simulated bridge tests are not Deck acceptance.
Do not import momentum writes, feature UI/scoring, packaging or unrelated ownership changes.
Authored predicate route has additional expression-hook dependencies; only consider if minimal request fails in measured context.

findings.finding: force_bail overrides the original selector result to wipeout300 when native selection rejects it; delivery also uses independently stored owner pointers.
findings.disposition: Do not copy the forced-state fallback or the whole plugin API. Prefer the native-request candidates above.

findings.finding: Current PR diff changes only PlayStation HID input filtering. No new curved-rail algorithm, Deck XInput change, grind entry or named Y selector.
findings.existing_method: Merged PR192 exit control already exists locally: post-entry six-step rail tangent, stance/travel exit side, native cross-rail launch modifier, trigger/lean guards. PR216 pop-strength work is also in upstream history.
findings.integration: Reuse existing hook and authored from_grind gestures for exit experiments. Current ClassicGesture hardfilters ground and start eligibility excludes grind; no new parser needed.
limits: Post-entry velocity tangent is not approaching rail geometry.
Gamepad filter and trajectory modifier setters are singletons; no competing hook.
Filter precedes Arcade remap and can consume LT/RT or LX.
Y entry/selection and independent named-grind observation remain open.

findings.available: Local-owner check for shared trajectory calls and manual-pop launch diagnostics/height scaling.
findings.integration: If manual-to-air classification needs another signal, reuse owner-filtered launch observation; retain native launch height.
limits: It scales an existing launch, does not trigger a manual or pop.
Its broad riding-state heuristic needs actual manual pose evidence before attributing a manual exit.
No need to import the slider or change gameplay tuning.

findings.finding: PR head unchanged. Older style-layer branch has no newer scripted playback fix.
findings.available: Persistent 60 m practice stage, verified arrival/return, map-generation guards, falling/streaming recovery; 60 Hz recorder, stable riding preparation and bounded retries.
findings.integration: Prepared flip playback A/B remains first hardware task. Reuse the isolated stage only if ordinary practice baseline is unstable; requires small missing stage-object API integration.
limits: Native flip reader is still the same persistent selection field; no occurrence counter.
Animation TrickTracker is not a scoring/banking oracle.
27/27 recordings with retries is not first-attempt repeatability.
No new exact grab/grind/revert result adapter found.

findings.finding: Preset changes native friction, landing angles, grind lock distances and wipeout thresholds.
findings.disposition: Do not apply global tuning as a substitute for targeted balance failure or exact Y mechanics.

findings.disposition: No missing Arcade mechanics or replacement HIL system found; preserve our existing accepted Deck infrastructure.
